messages.author: cf3eb0dff4b9d2d6
messages.subject: Parsing commands to xtable
parts:
I'm displaying data with renderTable / tableOutput, which works fine. Which got me to think if it is possible to parse extra commands to the underlying xtable.

For example: I don't want to show the rownames in Shiny. Normally this is done by: include.rownames=FALSE

Any ideas on how to do this?

messages.author: 19565bbb5a6e1f95
messages.subject: Re: Parsing commands to xtable
parts:
Hi,
Something like:
 
 output$result <- renderTable({
           resultValue()
       }, include.rownames = FALSE, include.colnames = FALSE)


?renderTable
 
      renderTable(expr, ..., env = parent.frame(),
         quoted = FALSE, func = NULL)

Arguments:
    ...: Arguments to be passed through to ‘xtable’ and
          ‘print.xtable’.

Cheers,
K.
